one_line: Larksuite's collaboration and chat suite (IM, Docs, Calendar, Base, Wiki, Meetings) with broad server-side REST APIs, events/webhooks, and an open-source CLI.
auth_notes: OAuth2 with app_id/app_secret issuing tenant- and user-scoped access tokens; custom apps created in the open platform console (open.larksuite.com).
self_serve_notes: Free self-serve developer account; create custom app, get credentials, and use test tenant for debugging.

api_surface.breadth_estimate: Server APIs and events across IM, Contacts, Calendar, Drive, Docs, Sheets, Base, Wiki, Meetings, Email, Approval, Search, Admin; hundreds of endpoints.
api_surface.webhook_note: Event subscriptions (webhooks) across all major domains for real-time delivery.

existing_mcp.note: Lark provides official MCP servers; open-source Lark CLI also available for agent use (npx @larksuite/cli).

evidence.note: Fetched text (024_lark.txt) confirms server APIs, events, permission scopes, app types, and Lark CLI. Auth method from knowledge.

agent_notes: 024_lark_larksuite.txt was a JS shell; relied on 024_lark.txt plus knowledge. MCP/official status inferred.
